title: Unlearning Under Imbalance: Benchmarking Fairness in Multimodal LLM Unlearning

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring Demographic Parity (DP) by calculating the absolute difference in the model's probability of predicting a textual target attribute (e.g., right-wing political orientation, tall height) based on the visually inferred gender of a fictitious identity in a held-out dataset.
